summary: On the main deck, Tank works furiously at the operator's station while the ship's turbines grind to a halt, plunging the deck into dark silence. The rest of the crew stands behind him as he whispers that power is off-line and the E.M.P. is armed and ready. He then curls his fingers around a small key that glows a dim red.

what_changes.before: Working furiously at the operator's station as the turbines whir
what_changes.after: The turbines grind to a halt and the deck is plunged into dark silence
what_changes.evidence: Tank works furiously at the operator's station as the ceaseless WHIR of the ship's TURBINES GRIND TO a HALT. The main deck is plunged into dark silence.

what_changes.before: Working at the station with power on-line
what_changes.after: Reports power off-line and the E.M.P. armed and ready, then grips the glowing key
what_changes.evidence: TANK Power off-line. E.M.P. armed and ready. Tank's fingers curl around a small key that glows a dim red.

event_hint.one_line: As the Nebuchadnezzar hides from the Sentinel, Tank powers down and readies the E.M.P. weapon.

objects_that_matter: small key that glows a dim red
uncertain: Who exactly 'the rest of the screw' (crew) standing behind Tank are, since this scene names only Tank.
Whether the E.M.P. has been fired yet or is merely prepared.
